topic: What trade-offs exist between reflector aperture size and feed element redundancy in robust antenna design?
response: In robust antenna design, larger reflector apertures can provide better gain and directivity, but may increase spillover loss. On the other hand, increasing feed element redundancy can improve system reliability, but may add complexity and weight. A trade-off exists between these two factors, as a larger aperture size can be offset by increased redundancy in the feed array.
